members.name: collect
members.doc: Run the garbage collector. With no arguments, run a full collection. The optional argument may be an integer specifying which generation to collect. A ValueErro

members.name: freeze
members.doc: Freeze all current tracked objects and ignore them for future collections. This can be used before a POSIX fork() call to make the gc copy-on-write friendly. No

members.name: get_count
members.doc: Return a three-tuple of the current collection counts.

members.name: get_debug
members.doc: Get the garbage collection debugging flags.

members.name: get_freeze_count
members.doc: Return the number of objects in the permanent generation.

members.name: get_objects
members.doc: Return a list of objects tracked by the collector (excluding the list returned). generation Generation to extract the objects from. If generation is not None, r

members.name: get_referents
members.doc: get_referents(*objs) -> list Return the list of objects that are directly referred to by objs.

members.name: get_referrers
members.doc: get_referrers(*objs) -> list Return the list of objects that directly refer to any of objs.

members.name: get_stats
members.doc: Return a list of dictionaries containing per-generation statistics.

members.name: is_finalized
members.doc: Returns true if the object has been already finalized by the GC.

members.name: is_tracked
members.doc: Returns true if the object is tracked by the garbage collector. Simple atomic objects will return false.

members.name: isenabled
members.doc: Returns true if automatic garbage collection is enabled.

members.name: set_debug
members.doc: Set the garbage collection debugging flags. flags An integer that can have the following bits turned on: DEBUG_STATS - Print statistics during collection. DEBUG

members.name: set_threshold
members.doc: set_threshold(threshold0, [threshold1, threshold2]) -> None Sets the collection thresholds. Setting threshold0 to zero disables collection.

members.name: unfreeze
members.doc: Unfreeze all objects in the permanent generation. Put all objects in the permanent generation back into oldest generation.
